relations.subject: clusters:deletion-protection
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: minted - camelCase verb phrase for a setting that, when enabled, prevents an operation (delete) from succeeding through any interface
relations.evidence: A cluster cannot be deleted from the UI, the [Management API](../management-api-reference/index.md#tag/Clusters/operation/deleteCluster), or external tools like Terraform, when deletion protection is turned on.

relations.subject: cloud/clusters/delete-database
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: minted - camelCase verb phrase for a lifecycle action that irreversibly removes a dependent resource as a side effect, not merely pausing or disconnecting it
relations.evidence: Deleting a cluster deletes its backups.

notable_absence.finding: Deletion carries no support-plan or edition gating in this page's own text - only a project role prerequisite. No edition badges or server-version-string citations either (both known recurring anomalies absent from this page).

cross_component_finding: Deletion protection, defined on modify-database.md, is only referenced here (via seeAlso) rather than explained - this page assumes the reader already knows what it is.
